recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed unless Patient Care reopens FHIR-37637 or requests a new current AllergyIntolerance note.
issue_request: FHIR-23812 was Published as Persuasive with Modification for AllergyIntolerance. It asked to keep the feedback note about extension-allergyintolerance-certainty but add a hyperlink to the extension so reviewers could find the referenced extension even though Certainty was no longer an AllergyIntolerance element.
initial_application: Commit 71ea30af657f9ff011a0e8eee1084a0ecc31e29e applied the Jira request by changing the AllergyIntolerance introduction note to link extension-allergyintolerance-certainty.html. Earlier history had already changed the note from AllergyIntolerance.reaction.certainty to the extension name after certainty moved to an extension.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is an active core resource in source/fhir.ini. Current source/allergyintolerance/allergyintolerance-introduction.xml no longer contains the note. Later Published issue FHIR-37637 found the same note misleading because it described the extension binding as required, and commit aa2dd3377555089ae988fa24d53442ccff62a4d9 removed it for R5. The extension is now present in the FHIR Extension Pack with an extensible binding, matching that later rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing the hyperlink would require reintroducing removed note text, which would conflict with the later applied FHIR-37637 decision.
